name: com.intentrax/mcp
title: Intentrax proof verification
description: Keyless, read-only checks of Intentrax AI-agent execution proofs. Never executes, signs, or writes.

tools.name: intentrax_verify_public_proof
tools.description: Look up a published proof by its ID on Intentrax's public verifier (verify.intentrax.com) and return the verifier's status and per-dimension assessment. Read-only. The hosted assessment covers the record integrity and signer checks done by Intentrax's service; it is not a check against keys pinned on the caller's side. A proof records an Intentrax decision; it does not show that an external effect happened.

proof_id.description: Published Intentrax proof identifier (usually a 64-character hex string).

tools.name: intentrax_get_trusted_key_set
tools.description: Return the published Ed25519 signer key set Intentrax proofs are checked against (production: trust-bearing, min_trusted_signers applies; sandbox: never trust-bearing), with its SHA-256, so the user can verify a proof offline with `npx @intentrax/sdk verify-proof --trusted-keys`. Read-only; no network call.

environment.description: Which published key set to return.

tools.name: intentrax_verify_proof_export
tools.description: Verify an exported proof package (the JSON from GET /v1/proofs/{id}/export or the console's Export button) against Intentrax's published production and sandbox keys, using the same verifier as `npx @intentrax/sdk verify-proof --json`. Pure computation: no network call, nothing is stored. status PASS means every signer is a published trust-bearing key and the signer threshold is met; SANDBOX_NON_TRUST_BEARING means the mechanics check out with sandbox keys only; FAILED_CLOSED means integrity or a signature did not verify. PASS does not show that an external effect happened; the result's verification_assessment and limitations list what was and was not assessed.

proof_export.description: The exported proof lookup package, as a JSON object (up to 1 MiB).
